item.title: Building an MVP for Content Personalization and Intelligence
item.description:
Building an MVP for a content personalization capability - not pure infrastructure, but proving the concept works before building the full thing.

Tight scope so it actually ships as an MVP instead of sprawling into something massive. Get something in front of stakeholders fast and find out if it’s worth investing further.
